INNER HEAD. [3] [Cub.]
Sensation as if head was choked up ; with heaviness of head and danger of suffocation. θ Croup.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Cub.]
Nausea and vomiting.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Cub.]
Burning in abdomen. θ Croup.
Sensation of weight, pressure, and pain in region of femoral ring, similar to that which precedes occurrence of femoral hernia ; downward pressure and weight < after walking, riding, lifting, and especially before and during menstrual period.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Cub.]
Countenance fallen, indicating great suffering ; discharges every half hour of transparent slime mixed with blood ; before stool severe griping pains in bowels, with backache ; with stool, the same, and urging to urinate ; after stool, long-continued tenesmus, and relief of pains, except heavy dull pain in back and bowels ; tongue flabby, white, furred ; throat dry ; little thirst < ; from food or drink. θ Dysentery.
Stools of colorless, transparent slime, mixed with bright blood, and plentifully interspersed with shining, white bodies, the shape of rice kernels. θ Dysentery.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Cub.]
Nocturnal enuresis.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Cub.]
Inflammation of urethra.
Prostatitis.
Secretion of mucus from urethra greatly increased.
Gonorrhœa, with profuse discharge and scalding pain whilst urinating ; pus very thick and glutinous ; excessive ardor urinæ and frequent desire to empty bladder.
Pale, copious, slimy discharge, causing soiled linen to become stiff ; sometimes, particularly after coitus, or use of spirituous liquors, sensation of warmth and slight burning in urethra on urinating. θ Gleet.
After six weeks, thick, yellow, pus-like discharge from urethra. θ Gonorrhœa.
After two months, profuse pus-like discharge, with painless urination, slight redness of meatus, no swelling of glans. θ Chronic gonorrhœa.
Thick, yellowish-green discharge, with frequent obstruction of urethra. θ Gonorrhœa.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Cub.]
Urethro-vaginitis, severe and of long standing, with acute pains and abundant discharge.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Cub.]
Respiration impeded, difficult, with crepitant rales ; great fulness of chest ; dyspnœa and sense of suffocation.
   

NERVES. [36] [Cub.]
Great restlessness ; extreme weakness.
   

FEVER. [40] [Cub.]
Cold sweat upon chest and back ; burning in abdomen. θ Croup.
